propositions: Commit 330c normalizes AC checkbox state (case-insensitive bullets, any form) to '[ ]' before hashing material fingerprints, so checkbox flips no longer invalidate plan-review attestations.

docs/plan-review-gate.md attestation invalidation section (§L469) does not document checkbox-state normalization, leading readers to believe any description edit including box flips stales attestations.
The AC-checkbox completeness precheck section (§L901) does not clarify that satisfying the precheck by checking boxes is fingerprint-safe and does not stale attestations.
Documentation updates to plan-review-gate.md must clarify that only item-text edits invalidate attestations; checkbox-state changes are normalized out of the material fingerprint.
